notes.title: Rustler - Early Access Release and Loyalty Discount
notes.notes:
Dear all!
We are happy to announce the launch of the Early Access version of Rustler!

Owners of this game will get the 25% Loyalty DISCOUNT when buying Rustler!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8192145/78decb7ee9e41d26087f2e9c88a6965e64a2f629.png[/img] 

Experience feudal injustice, witch-hunting and join big tournaments. Meet valiant, yet incredibly stupid knights. Complete a wide variety of twisted missions and quests... or don’t give a damn about the plot and bring mayhem in the villages and cities. Choose to go on foot or by a stolen horse. Fight with a sword or pick a fancy automatic crossbow. All that spiced up with an inappropriate Monty Python inspired sense of humor!

There's no time to wait - discount is available only till February 24th! Buy Rustler now and ride Your Horse! 🐴




https://store.steampowered.com/app/844260/Rustler_Grand_Theft_Horse/)

notes.title: Car Trader Simulator - Early Access Release and Loyalty Discount
notes.notes:
Dear all!

We are happy to announce the launch of Early Access version of [b]Car Trader Simulator[/b] - a game about fast auctions, buying cars, repairing and selling them with great profit to customers - all while building your own car trading empire and becoming really rich!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29076066/b52ab217d6e21719b7e51523af45170c59854a45.png[/img]

The game comes with a campaign mode where you can play through 3 different paths allowing yourself to become either a lawful, down to earth tradesman or to side with the mafia and build your business by illegal means. This coupled with the sandbox mode means that you're in for hours of great fun being the best car dealer you can be! 

Feel free to check out the trailer for the game to see how the game presents itself!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gcn1UI4snk8

We're releasing the game with [b]the special 10% EA launch[/b] discount and you can start playing right away for only $9.99!

Additionally, if you have any of the games from the list below you'll receive [b]an additional 15% loyalty discount[/b]! Be sure to not miss the chance!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/689980/Car_Trader_Simulator

See you soon in the game!

notes.title: Total Modifications DLC + Update 1.1.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/361840/ss_bc92c8c20629fd600205a0fa206c28ed3e2b5d4d.1920x1080.jpg?t=1487618650[/img]

In Total Modification DLC you will have unique sandbox mode for all of you, which want to have some unlimited fun and not bothering about game money. 
Also all 13 cars from this DLC will have unique modifications, which you cannot do yourself in game. Similar to modding, but it will not break your game saves or replace standard cars.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/361840/ss_c4dbb456892f41626c0347c9ab1ecbeaf485b862.600x338.jpg?t=1487618650[/img]

Collection of 13 classic Car Mechanic Simulator's cars modificated in a crazy way. Lowered suspensions, big rims, crazy engine swaps, and many more!
This DLC will also introduce you to Sandbox Mode in which you can play with all cars, and not worry about money or upgrades! Jump into instant fun mode!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/361840/ss_e0b8ca3acbd73b6f1f48dc6eacb0b6d80b1936fc.600x338.jpg?t=1487618650[/img]

Modified cars in this DLC :
Maluch Drag V6
Bolt Reptilia Slammed V8
Sakura Moon AWD W12
Tempest Magnum AWD W12
Rino Piccolo Monster
Salem Kieran L6
Salem Flamo Drag V8
Delray Custom AWD W12
Mayen M8 Race
Echos Cobra Drag
Sakura GT20 Drag V8
Castor Earthquake DUB
Katagiri Katsumoto JDM

All cars could be bought via Auction Room.

To access Sandbox Mode, just create new profile and tick Sandbox Mode checkbox.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/361840

notes.title: Expert Mode + update 1.0.6.3
notes.notes:
[img]http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/527291846445386196/BC2D510BE6E5BA675ED69D1A452B52DF0C3D72F2/[/img]

Expert Mode is here! Create new profile to try it out first. You can always convert your old save in profiles menu, but think twice - because it's only one way process. If you will request converting from expert back to normal - we could add it in next patch.

Changelog : 
- EXPERT MODE :
* no tutorial on new game
* no jobs with listed parts (only body repairs and filters will have listed parts)
* game is not showing blocked parts
* very limited gui
* no parts access description
* no silhouette around bolts - you need to know where they are
* auction fee - 1000$
* lowered bonus for car restoration (50% compared to normal mode)
* raised xp bonus (200% compared to normal mode)
* no information about over cursor part condition
* job task bonus reduced by 50%
* job complete bonues raised by 50%
* rust on parts calculated different way
- added CX (drag coefficients) for car physics
- added Drag area calculation for car physics
- added FOV slider in options menu
- new translations for Czech language
- new translations for Italian language

Let us know what you think on https://www.facebook.com/RedDotGames/

notes.notes:
Hello!

Here are some updates on what we're doing. During this week we will be releasing new DLC called Trader Pack. 3 cars were chosen by Steam community and we have only a few small bits to add before releasing so stay tuned.

We are also making the game more stable since some of you did report outline problems on mac or game crashes on pc. Hopefully in this version it will be reduced - if you have any issues remember to report them on Steam discussions group.

Thanks to Alexandre Maier, we added Portuguese Brasil into languages and with a help of Vitaly Senkov we have fully translated Russian localization.

For those of you who wait for custom key mapping - we are still working on it :)

Will be back soon with Trader Pack DLC update 1.0.5.0!

- fixed parts showing before too fast while mounting
- updated engine to newest version
- disabled dynamic batching to fix outline problems on mac
- added Portuguese Brazil language
- added Czech language (beta)
- added missing Russian translations
- checking money balance before painting car
- better paint preview in paint shop
- increased max zoom out distance for parts camera
- fixed parts transparent shader
- fixed rev limiter
- reduced RAM usage by 10%

notes.title: Update 1.0.3.2 - New Classic Car - Salem Kieran
notes.notes:
We just finished adding a new car that is available right now after upgrading to 1.0.3.2 version.

Also worth mentioning is a cool new highlighting tool inside Order Info that will allow you to highlight selected parts (those parts need to be discovered first). This should help you with some harder jobs when you need replace parts which are hard to find or parts which quantity is more than 1 (push rods, bushing etc.) To use it - click on star to mark part as "important". This parts will always stay highlighten on cyan color.

Changelog :

[h1]1.0.3.2[/h1]
- NEW CLASSIC CAR (Salem Kieran) 
- parts highlighting tool for order info
- credits fix
- more bug fixes related to tablet
- fixed dof focus issues in path test
- bolt hellcat model fixes
- bolt reptilia model fixes
- increased bolt ray length

http://www.metacritic.com/game/pc/car-mechanic-simulator-2015
Thanks!

notes.title: Update 1.0.3.0 - tablet upgrade, game balancing and more
notes.notes:
Changelog :
[h1]1.0.3.0[/h1]
- TABLET UPDATE (access computer from any part of garage and order info)
- you now gain XP for repairing parts
- flywheel is now under "gearbox" sections of inventory/shops
- pausing has been blocked when loading new job
- game balancing :
paint shop from 5000 xp (was 6000)
path test from 2500 xp (was 3000)
body repair / painting jobs are now generated from 4000 xp (was 3000 xp)
lowered job tasks amount at <5000 XP
- customer cars will now not have parts at lower condition than required minimal condition of parts to repair it
- 4 new songs in radio
- small changes in localization files for all languages
- changed sound effects of inventory items and confirmation windows on to more subtle ones
- phone ring sound more subtle
- added credits for community localization help (if you helped fixing it, and you not on list - let us know!)
- raised camera X limit by 5 degree
- corrected italian translation
- corrected russian translation

And as always - let us know what you think about update on steam discussions!
